subject: Acme Renewal & Expansion — Usage Review and Next Steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>, Emily Cho <emily.cho@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Renewal & Expansion — Usage Review and Next Steps

Hi John / Emily,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the open discussion. Quick recap from our call + proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

What we reviewed
- Current usage: ~1.8M tokens/month across the web search and summarization pipelines (Q3 export attached).
- Pain points: 1) cost unpredictability during peak batch jobs, 2) latency spikes on long-context reranks, 3) need for on-prem option for the compliance team for specific datasets.
- Business goal: Reduce inference cost by ~30% while maintaining 95th percentile latency SLAs for user-facing flows, and enable secure private deployments for regulated workloads next year.

Opportunities discussed
- Dedicated capacity pool for summarization workload to stabilize latency and price.
- Quantization + model variant recommendation for reranking to hit cost targets.
- Private deployment pilot (VPC) for three regulated pipelines — start with a proof-of-concept in Q1.

Attachments
- usage_report_Q3.xlsx (attached) — token breakdown by service and spike windows.
- draft_proposal_v1.pdf (attached) — high-level pricing bands and recommended timeline for Dedicated + Private pilot.

Requested next steps
1) Can you confirm the three pipelines you want in the Private pilot (suggested: Claims Intake, Legal Summaries, and Credentialing)? Reply with any adjustments by end of next week.
2) If the Dedicated pool looks good, we can schedule a technical kickoff with Marcus for environment sizing — propose Dec 1 or Dec 3 (30–45 minutes).
3) Marissa to update the draft proposal with pilot scoping and a 12-month pricing commit option.

John / Emily — any corrections to the above? If not, I will update the proposal and lock in a kickoff date with Marcus + Vivek.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: usage_report_Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: draft_proposal_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Cho <emily.cho@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Renewal & Expansion — Usage Review and Next Steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- The three pipelines for the Private pilot look right to me: Claims Intake, Legal Summaries, Credentialing.
- On the Dedicated pool sizing, we typically see heavy batch jobs on Tuesdays/Thursdays between 02:00–04:00 PT; Dec 1 works better for our infra team (Dec 3 overlaps with an internal release).
- A couple questions on the draft proposal: can you add a line item for short-term overage protection during the pilot? Also include expected latency at p95 for the proposed model variants.

Otherwise, all good — please proceed with the kickoff scheduling for Dec 1 and send calendar invites for Marcus and Vivek.

Best,
John
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Corp
john.doe@acme.com | +1 555-0166

Thanks — looping in a short technical plan based on Marissa / John’s notes. Reposting key items and owners so we can move quickly: 

Summary of technical asks
- Dedicated capacity pool sizing for summarization workload (owner: Marcus) — need token distribution by hour (from usage_report_Q3).
- Quantization + model variant evaluation for reranking (owner: Marcus & ModelOps) — we will run benchmark tests on 3 candidate variants and report p50/p95 latency and quality delta.
- Private (VPC) pilot for three pipelines (owner: Vivek) — scope: infra setup, KMS integration, and audit log forwarding.

Immediate next steps (timeline)
- Nov 24: Marissa to share final list of pipelines and confirm pilot contacts (ACME side).
- Dec 1 (10:00 AM PT): Technical kickoff (30–45m) — Marcus, Vivek, ACME infra (John + Emily). I’ll send a calendar invite for Dec 1 10:00 AM PT.
- Dec 2–10: Benchmark window for model quantization tests.
- Dec 15: Draft pilot runbook and final pricing adjustment for overage protection.

Notes: We will include an overage protection clause in the proposal as requested — propose a fixed buffer for the first 60 days of the pilot that caps additional charges at 15% of committed spend. Marissa, will add this language to draft_proposal_v1.pdf and circulate.

Marcus
Senior Customer Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
